title: Identifying slow relaxation in many-body quantum systems through state-graph geometry and state-graph heterogeneity
summary: We adapt tools from the theory of quantum random walks to investigate slow relaxation dynamics through the many-body state graph. Specifically, we construct a probe of heterogeneity between basis states defined using hitting times derived from the unitary time-evolution operator. We find that the state-graph geometry, encoded by the pairwise hitting time of basis states, is a highly sensitive indicator of slow relaxation dynamics in a variety of systems.
